| description = Basil is the easier of the two enemies spawned by the [[Langseax]] quest.  He spawns significantly more often and is drastically easier than his counterpart, [[Paglan]].  The wiki previously stated this enemy is a Rogue, this did not appear to be true, I let him attack me in the back for awhile and he never attempted a backstab and I never got a feeling he was getting an extra attack from attempting a frontal backstab.  As a level 25 Dwarf Warrior, he never hit me for more than 39 in a single hit and was quite easy to solo.

There have been occasional reports of him spawning elsewhere, but in ~4 1/2 hours of repeating this quest both [[Basil]] and [[Paglan]] spawned near #16 on the [[West Karana]] map and wandered slightly around that mountain top every single time. Basil is soloable by a level 24 barbarian warrior with shop bought 13/51 two handed hammer and 71 worn AC.
